requirement: Verify applicable fiber-content, country-of-origin, and responsible-business identification labeling requirements for the garment.
notes: Most textile and wool products are subject to federal labeling requirements. Applicability should be verified for the specific product.

requirement: Verify applicable care-labeling requirements and ensure appropriate care instructions are provided for the garment.
notes: The Care Labeling Rule covers textile wearing apparel and requires appropriate care information.

requirement: Verify that the garment contains the required country-of-origin information and that the placement and presentation are appropriate for the product.
evidenceNeeded: Packaging or hang tag where applicable
notes: Country-of-origin requirements depend on the product and manufacturing circumstances.

requirement: Determine whether the clothing textile is subject to the applicable flammability requirements and whether the required performance/testing evidence is available.
notes: CPSC identifies 16 CFR Part 1610 as the general wearing apparel flammability standard. Applicability and any testing exemptions should be verified for the specific material and garment.

requirement: Determine whether product-specific testing or other evidence is applicable and maintain supporting records.
notes: Testing requirements depend on the specific product, material and applicable requirements.

requirement: Maintain product, supplier, material, labeling and testing evidence needed to support the compliance assessment.
notes: The exact evidence set depends on the product and applicable requirements.
